body.text: What tests (MRI, cardiac echo, blood panels, endoscopy, cancer markers) are included in a 1-day check-up?

Comprehensive executive packages at major Istanbul hospital groups bundle fasting metabolic, lipid, thyroid, liver, kidney, and vitamin blood panels with resting ECG, echocardiography, exercise stress testing, chest imaging, and abdominal ultrasound in a single morning circuit. Higher-tier panels add whole-body 3T MRI, coronary CT calcium scoring, tumor markers, or sedated gastroscopy and colonoscopy.

Preventive screening protocols vary by age, sex, and family history, so an internal medicine specialist reviews your intake questionnaire first to avoid unnecessary radiation or low-value testing. Hospitals with Joint Commission International (JCI) accreditation—including campuses within [Acıbadem Healthcare Group](https://acibademinternational.com/best-jci-accredited-hospitals-in-turkey/), [Memorial Hospital Group](https://www.memorial.com.tr/en/corporate/qualit-management-system), [Anadolu Medical Center](https://www.anadolumedicalcenter.com/quality-certificate/jci-joint-commission-international), and [Liv Hospital](https://www.livhospital.com/en/2024-jci-certificate)—typically assign a dedicated check-up floor so you move between stations without waiting in general outpatient queues.
How do Istanbul's JCI hospitals compare to London, Zurich or Dubai on cost and speed?

Istanbul's JCI-accredited private hospitals deliver multi-specialty diagnostics in one to two consecutive days—often booked within one week of enquiry—at 50% to 75% below equivalent Western European or Swiss fees. Patients avoid fragmented referrals that take weeks across separate imaging centers and specialist rooms at home.

Published 2026 benchmarks from [CureMeAbroad's executive health check-up analysis](https://curemeabroad.com/treatments/executive-healthcheck/costs) note that comprehensive Western packages costing USD 5,000 to USD 12,000 frequently run USD 1,000 to USD 3,000 abroad, while [MyPremiumEurope's Swiss screening cost guide](https://www.mypremiumeurope.com/health/health-screening/costs.htm) cites CHF 2,200 to CHF 4,500 for check-ups in Switzerland alongside programs at [University Hospital Zurich (USZ)](https://www.usz.ch/en/medical-check-up-preventive-medical-examination-at-the-usz/) and [King's College Hospital London in Dubai](https://kingscollegehospitaldubai.com/service/health-checkups-dubai/).

body.text: How long do lab and radiology results take to receive in English?

Routine blood panels, ECG, echocardiography, and ultrasound findings are usually reviewed with your internal medicine physician the same afternoon or the following morning. Specialized hormone assays, cancer biomarkers, pathology biopsies from endoscopy, and formal radiologist MRI interpretations typically require 24 to 72 hours (or up to five business days for tissue biopsies).

Before leaving the hospital, ask the international patient desk to deliver your complete dossier in English—both printed and digital—including original DICOM imaging files on USB or encrypted cloud link so your home doctor can inspect raw scans rather than summaries alone.

items: Fast for 10 to 12 hours before morning blood draws (still water permitted unless endoscopy is scheduled)
Confirm in advance whether sedated endoscopy requires a light-prep day prior to testing
Request bilingual English lab reference ranges alongside physician review notes
Collect raw DICOM radiology files and a signed closing summary before departing Istanbul

body.text: Can you pair an executive check-up with a 4-day Istanbul leisure or business trip?

Yes. Scheduling your fasting check-up on Day 1 morning frees the rest of a four-day Istanbul stay for business meetings, Bosphorus dining, or museum visits while final lab and radiology reports are compiled. If your panel includes sedated colonoscopy or gastroscopy, keep that afternoon strictly for hotel rest and hold flights or dinners until Day 2.

faq.q: How far in advance should I book an executive health check-up in Istanbul?
faq.a: Booking two to three weeks ahead usually secures your preferred morning slot, English-speaking internal medicine review, and MRI or endoscopy availability on the same day.

faq.q: Do I need to stay overnight in the hospital for a full-body check-up?
faq.a: No. Executive check-ups are outpatient programs lasting four to seven hours. Even sedated gastroscopy or colonoscopy is completed as a day procedure, though you should not drive or attend formal meetings that afternoon.

faq.q: Are tumor marker blood tests enough to rule out cancer?
faq.a: No. Blood markers alone can produce false positives or miss early tumors; your physician determines whether age-appropriate imaging, endoscopy, or targeted screening is clinically justified.

faq.q: Can couples book executive check-ups on the same morning?
faq.a: Yes. Most JCI-accredited Istanbul hospitals schedule partners concurrently on the same executive floor so both finish morning testing together.

faq.q: Does Itinerary of Türkiye choose my diagnostic tests or take hospital commissions?
faq.a: No. Paid by our clients. Independent of provider commissions. We coordinate your visit. Your licensed medical team makes clinical decisions, including every test recommendation and result interpretation.
